spec.title: SGLang: KV Cache Token Usage
spec.description: KV cache pool breakdown. Stacked: actively used (kv_used_tokens) + evictable/radix-cached (kv_evictable_tokens) = total used. Overlaid as a dashed ceiling: max_total_num_tokens (pool capacity). The gap between the stack top and the ceiling is the free capacity (kv_available_tokens).

spec.expr: max by(job, dp_rank, model_name) (sglang:max_total_num_tokens{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server", dp_rank=~"$dp_rank"})

spec.title: SGLang: Detailed Queue Statistics
spec.description: Internal scheduler sub-queues (overlap scheduler + distributed KV transfer pipeline). Prefill Bootstrap: requests waiting for KV bootstrap before prefill. Prefill Inflight: requests being prefilled. Decode Prealloc: prefilled requests waiting for decode KV slot preallocation. Decode Transfer: requests waiting for cross-worker KV migration before decode. These are usually 0 for single-engine online serving; they become non-zero under prefill/decode overlap pressure or distributed (PD-disaggregated) KV transfer.

spec.description: KV cache transfer performance

spec.title: SGLang: Token Usage
spec.description: Overall KV cache token usage (token_usage) and pending preallocated token usage (pending_prealloc_token_usage)

spec.title: SGLang: Paused & Retracted Requests
spec.description: Paused and retracted requests

spec.title: SGLang: Generation Throughput
spec.description: Generation throughput in tokens per second

spec.title: SGLang: Prompt Token Length
spec.description: Prompt (prefill) token length distribution: P99/P95/P50 and average, computed from the prompt_tokens_histogram. Note: this metric is recorded without a model_name label on some builds; the $model_name filter is applied where the label exists.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_histogram_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

spec.title: SGLang: Generation Token Length
spec.description: Generation (output) token length distribution: P99/P95/P50 and average, computed from the generation_tokens_histogram.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

spec.title: SGLang: Time To First Token (TTFT)
spec.description: Time To First Token (TTFT) latency: P99/P95/P50 and average, from the time_to_first_token_seconds histogram. Measures prefill + queue time before the first decoded token.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

spec.title: SGLang: Time Per Output Token (TPOT)
spec.description: Time Per Output Token (TPOT), approximated by the inter_token_latency_seconds histogram (latency between successive generated tokens): P99/P95/P50 and average.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])) / sum by(model_name, job) (rate(sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval]))

spec.title: SGLang: KV Cache Eviction Speed
spec.description: Tokens evicted from the GPU KV cache to CPU per second (rate of evicted_tokens_total). Sustained non-zero values indicate the KV cache is full and tokens are being reclaimed under pressure. Labeled by cache_type and job only (no model_name).

spec.title: SGLang: Request Prompt Length
spec.description: Heatmap of request prompt length, from the prompt_tokens_histogram. Each cell is the request count in a length bucket over the interval. Note: this histogram is labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).

spec.title: SGLang: Request Generation Length
spec.description: Heatmap of request generation length, from the generation_tokens_histogram. Each cell is the request count in a length bucket over the interval. Note: this histogram is labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).

spec.title: SGLang: Time To First Token (TTFT) Heatmap
spec.description: Heatmap of Time To First Token (TTFT), from the time_to_first_token_seconds histogram. Each cell is the request count in a latency bucket over the interval. Labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).

spec.title: SGLang: Speculative Decoding Acceptance Rate
spec.description: Average acceptance rate of speculative decoding

spec.title: SGLang: Time Per Output Token (TPOT) Heatmap
spec.description: Heatmap of inter-token latency (TPOT proxy), from the inter_token_latency_seconds histogram. Each cell is the token count in a latency bucket over the interval. Labeled by model_name only (no engine/worker label).

spec.title: SGLang: Running Requests
spec.description: Number of requests currently running (num_running_reqs)

spec.title: SGLang: Layer Token Usage
spec.description: Per-layer token usage: SWA layers (swa_token_usage) and Mamba/SSM layers (mamba_usage). Relevant for hybrid-SSM / hybrid-SWA models.

spec.title: SGLang: E2E Request Latency
spec.description: End-to-end request latency percentiles (e2e_request_latency_seconds). This metric carries only model_name (no dp_rank/job label).

spec.title: SGLang: Prefill Latency

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, job, model_name) (rate(sglang:per_stage_req_latency_seconds_bucket{stage="prefill_forward", model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, job, model_name) (rate(sglang:per_stage_req_latency_seconds_bucket{stage="prefill_forward", model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, job, model_name) (rate(sglang:per_stage_req_latency_seconds_bucket{stage="prefill_forward", model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$server"}[$interval])))

spec.title: SGLang: Decode Latency
spec.description: Decode per-step latency proxied by inter-token latency percentiles (inter_token_latency_seconds). This metric carries only model_name (no dp_rank/job label).

spec.title: SGLang: E2E Request Latency
spec.description: End-to-end request latency percentiles (e2e_request_latency_seconds). This metric carries only model_name (no dp_rank/job label).

spec.description: Token processing rate (tokens/s) from realtime_tokens_total, summed across dp_rank and split by mode (prefill_compute / prefill_cache / decode). Window = $interval.
